rows.en: Yeah. I also want to know what's happening back in the worlds we came from.
And to do that, we've got to unravel the mysteries of this world.
That's right.
Good. Then before we start investigating, let's settle one thing.
Fortunately, there are no threatening "enemies" in this place.
What's more, some of the facility's functions still work.
And we can treat our wounds in the regeneration capsules, too.
There's also equipment we could use if we repair it.
So I'm thinking we use this place as our "base".
Agreed!
I've got no objections.
I'll follow your lead.
Good. Then everyone, get yourselves ready for the investigation.
Once you're ready, gather at the "Hangar".
Roger!!
Right!
What is this place...? Looks like some kind of city...
Hong Kong City...? Dakar...?
No, that's not it. This place is...
Fuuto.
Fuuto?
Yeah. The town I live in, the City of Wind.
There's the proof: Fuuto Tower. It's the symbol of the city.
But something's off... The wind isn't blowing...
Um...
Maybe it's just me, but it also kind of looks like the town I was living in...
...It's just a hunch, though.
Anyway, let's explore a bit.
The shutter is closed.
It's a Ride Vendor...!
This vending machine thing... If I recall, OOO's town is full of these.
...Which means this place combines features of both W's and OOO's cities?
By the way, what can you buy from this thing?
It sells handy items called Candroids, but unfortunately I don't have any Cell Medals on me...
No, before we even get to that... it doesn't seem to be working...
Same as that shutter earlier. It looks like the whole city has shut down.
Probably because the wind has stopped.
Zero, what is it?
I sense an Ultra Warrior's presence beyond this shutter...
What...?
They might have been pulled in, just like us...
And there's one more... This is...
Ultraman Hikari...!
Those two probably got pulled into this world too.
Then let's go over there and find out!
No... no good. It won't open. Looks like this one's shut down too.
Then we'll just have to force it open!!
Seiyaaah!!!
But the shutter didn't open.
Because of the anomaly, their true powers seem to have been severely weakened.
It's no use... I can't get any strength into it...
If it's come to this, we'll just have to find some way to get the city running again.
A Nemo...!
Are you all right!?
Hang in there!!
But the Nemo was already dead.
There was a deep gash where something had slashed it. That must have been the fatal wound.
One of the Nemo squad... Back in our world, they were our side's main force...
I wonder what happened to the other Nemos...
They might be somewhere nearby...
Then the enemy that killed this Nemo might still be around here too, right?
Who's there!?
...Accel!! So you ended up here too!!
That's my line.
I got caught up in that anomaly, and by the time I came to, I was already in this world.
Oh, then it's the same for me.
I thought as much. Hm? ...And who are these people?
Same deal with them. Looks like they got pulled in here from their own worlds.
So it wasn't just Fuuto... ...Well, whatever.
I'm Kamen Rider Accel. Nice to meet you.
Oh, right. Let me give you all a warning.
There's an invisible enemy lurking around here. I've been attacked by it a few times myself.
If you're going on ahead, you'd better be very careful.
Accel, aren't you coming?
W... You do realize the wind isn't blowing at all, right?

notes.note: OP rows 0.89-0.104 have no recovered speaker. From story_001 context: 0.89 likely Zero or W, 0.90 likely OOO, 0.92-0.97 and 0.101-0.102 Nu Gundam (the leader proposing the base), 0.98 likely OOO, 0.100 likely Zero (he calls Nu Gundam 'anta' earlier). 0.95 could be W or Nu. Lines written to work for any of these.

Source says 'the world (I/we) came from' with no possessor; rendered 'the worlds we came from' since each hero has a different world. If the speaker means only his own world, 'my world' would also fit.
'base' and 'Hangar' keep the source's quotation marks; they look like hub/menu terms. Check against the UI translation of the hub facility names (not in glossary).
'regeneration capsules' for the regenerative-treatment capsule; check UI term for the healing facility.
Probably several party members in chorus; 'Roger!!' used. 0.104 'Right!' likewise a group/other member response.
No speaker recovered for 0101 #0.3-0.8; context (identifies Fuuto as his home town) makes it W (Shotaro). #0.5 'Fuuto?' is someone else, likely Zero or OOO.
Hong Kong City and Dakar are Zeta Gundam locations; Nu Gundam (Amuro) guessing places from his world.
No speaker; treated as examine/narration text.
'Ride Vendor' and 'Candroid' are the established Kamen Rider OOO English names; not in glossary terms (Taka Candroid is).
The first Ultra Warrior is unnamed here, so 'They' (gender-neutral) is kept. #0.6-0.8 have no speaker but continue Zero's line of thought (he names Hikari).
OOO's signature shout, kept as 'Seiyaaah!!!' for recognisability.
Silence row with no speaker; kept as an ellipsis.

Nemo is a mobile suit model treated as a person. Glossary g = n, so pronouns avoided; 'it' used in #0.7 for the body/wound. OOO uses the honorific '-san' in #0.11; rendered as 'this Nemo' rather than a gendered title.
'Nemo squad' for the Nemo unit (Nemo A / Nemo B in the speaker list).
'???' speaker is Accel before he is revealed (W names him in #0.3).
'yoroshiku na' here is a self-introduction greeting, not a request; 'Nice to meet you.'
proofread: 'before that' read as temporal; source means 'never mind that, it isn't even working'.

proofread: OP script 1100.bla gives the speakers: 0.89 W (Shotaro), 0.90 OOO, 0.91-0.94 Nu Gundam, 0.95 W, 0.96 OOO, 0.97 Nu, 0.98 OOO, 0.99 W, 0.100 Zero, 0.101-0.102 Nu, 0.103 OOO, 0.104 W. English fits them; unchanged. 0101 #0.3-0.8 and 0104 #0.6-0.8 are never played by their scripts.

report: 80/80 rows examined. No rows over 100 chars. Uncertain: OP 0.89-0.104 speakers unrecovered (inferred from story_001); 0101 #0.3-0.8 and 0104 #0.6-0.8 speakers inferred (W Shotaro / Zero). Terms not in glossary: Ride Vendor, Candroid, Hong Kong City, Dakar, Nemo squad, regeneration capsule, base, Hangar.
